questions.question: Mohan purchased trousers for Rs. 765, after a discount of 15% was offered on its marked price. What is the marked price (in Rs.) of the trousers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Fraction value of 15% discount = −3/20, meaning Marked Price (MP) = 20 units and Selling Price (SP) = 17 units.

Given SP = 17 units = Rs. 765

1 unit = 765 ÷ 17 = Rs. 45

MP = 20 units = 45 × 20 = 900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of trousers = Rs. 765

Discount offered = 15%

**Formula Used:**

MP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 − Discount%)]

 
 Marked Price
 100%

 
 Selling Price
 85% = Rs. 765

 
• 
 

 − 15% Discount

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100%.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100% − 15% = 85%

⇒ According to the question, 85% of MP = Rs. 765

⇒ MP = 765 × (100 ÷ 85)

⇒ MP = 765 × (20 ÷ 17)

⇒ MP = 45 × 20 = 900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) while Profit or Loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise.

Relationship between MP and CP

If a profit of P% is made after allowing a discount of D%, then the ratio of MP to CP is determined by MP ÷ CP = (100 + P) ÷ (100 − D).

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are offered, the equivalent single discount given is (a + b − a×b ÷ 100)%.
</p

questions.question: In April 2019, Dinesh purchased a new car for Rs. 7,00,000 and sold it in April 2022 at its depreciated cost. If the rate of depreciation in the first year is 20%, 15% in the second year and 10% every year thereafter, what amount of money will Dinesh get as the selling price?
questions.solution:
Given:

Annual depreciation of car value = 20%, 15% and 10%

Cost = 7,00,000

Concept used:

If P is the initial price of the commodity, then after ‘n’ years the value of the commodity will become P × [1 – (n/100)]

Calculation:

Percentage fall in price after 3 years = 700000 × (100 - 20)/100 × (100 - 15)/100 × (100 - 10)/100 

⇒ 700000 × 8/10 × 85/100 × 9/10

⇒ 70 × 8 × 85 × 9

⇒ 428400

**The answer is 428400**

questions.question: In a village election between three candidates, 80% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 3% votes were declared invalid. The winning candidate got 42,680 votes which were 55% of the total valid votes. Find the number of valid votes received by the candidate who stood third, given that he received only 10% of the total valid votes.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **winning candidate** got 55% of **valid votes**, which is 42,680.

The **third candidate** got 10% of **valid votes**.

Using the unitary method: 55% → 42,680

1% → 42,680 ÷ 55 = 776

10% → 776 × 10 = 7,760

**∴ The correct answer is 7760.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Votes of the **Winner** = 42,680

Winner's share = 55% of **Total Valid Votes**

Third candidate's share = 10% of **Total Valid Votes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a90f07ef2b64c4b3c63426392dcf5a70eccc6fee77016edc0766adee0cdacaba.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the **Total Valid Votes** be V.

⇒ 55% of V = 42,680

⇒ (55 ÷ 100) × V = 42,680

⇒ V = (42,680 × 100) ÷ 55

⇒ V = 776 × 100

⇒ V = 77,600

The **third candidate** received 10% of these valid votes:

⇒ Votes = 10% of 77,600

⇒ Votes = (10 ÷ 100) × 77,600

⇒ Votes = 7,760

**∴ The correct answer is 7760.**

**__Additional Information__**

Valid Votes vs Invalid Votes

Valid votes are those which are correctly marked and counted. Total Cast Votes = Valid Votes + Invalid Votes.

Winning Margin

The margin of victory is the difference in votes between the first-place candidate and the second-place candidate.

Voter Turnout

Voter turnout is the percentage of eligible voters who cast a ballot. Cast Votes = Total Voters × Turnout Percentage.</p

questions.question: A train starts from a station P for another station Q at 6 p.m. at an average speed of 75 km per hour. Another train starts from station Q for station P at 8 p.m. at an average speed of 105 km per hour. If the distance between these two stations is 690 km, then at what time will the two trains meet?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by the first train in 2 hours = 75 × 2 = 150 km.

Remaining distance at 8 p.m. = 690 − 150 = 540 km.

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 75 + 105 = 180 km/h.

Time to meet = 540 ÷ 180 = 3 hours.

Meeting time = 8:00 p.m. + 3 hours = 11:00 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance between stations P and Q = 690 km

Speed of the train starting from P at 6 p.m. = 75 km/h

Speed of the train starting from Q at 8 p.m. = 105 km/h

 
•

**Calculations:**

⇒ The first train travels alone for 2 hours (from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.).

⇒ Distance covered by the first train = 75 × 2 = 150 km.

⇒ Remaining distance between the two trains at 8 p.m. = 690 − 150 = 540 km.

⇒ From 8 p.m. onwards, both trains move towards each other.

⇒ Relative speed = Speed of train P + Speed of train Q = 75 + 105 = 180 km/h.

⇒ Time taken to cover the remaining distance = Distance ÷ Relative speed

⇒ Time taken = 540 ÷ 180 = 3 hours.

⇒ The two trains will meet 3 hours after 8 p.m.

⇒ Meeting time = 8:00 p.m. + 3 hours = 11:00 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects travel towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects travel in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their speeds (|S₁ − S₂|).

Meeting Time Formula

Meeting Time = Total Initial Distance between them ÷ Relative Speed.
</p

questions.question: The perimeter of a parallelogram is 48 cm. If the height of the parallelogram is 6 cm and the length of the adjacent side is 8 cm, find its area.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of adjacent sides = **Perimeter** ÷ 2 = 48 ÷ 2 = 24 cm.

Base of the parallelogram = 24 − 8 = 16 cm.

**Area** = Base × Height = 16 × 6 = 96 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Perimeter** of parallelogram = 48 cm

⇒ Length of one **adjacent side** (b) = 8 cm

⇒ **Height** (h) of the parallelogram = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (Side₁ + Side₂)

⇒ Area = **Base** × **Height**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3afbec8c23573d2d29d13f48ddab286acb88782c07749c12adccadb17d97f34c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 48 = 2 × (Base + 8)

⇒ 24 = Base + 8

⇒ **Base** = 24 − 8 = 16 cm

⇒ **Area** = 16 × 6

⇒ **Area** = 96 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of Parallelogram

The area can be calculated as Area = a × b × sin(θ), where a and b are adjacent sides and θ is the angle between them.

Height and Side Relationship

In a parallelogram, the product of a side and its corresponding altitude is constant: Area = Base₁ × Height₁ = Base₂ × Height₂.

Properties of Parallelogram

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, and diagonals bisect each other.</p

questions.question: Ali, Avtar Singh and Ashok working together can finish a work in 8 days. Ali alone can do it in 20 days and Avtar Singh alone can do it in 24 days. In how many days can Ashok alone do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given**

**Concept used**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation**

Total work = LCM of 8, 20 and 24 = 120 units

Total efficiency = 120/8 = 15 unit/day

Ali's efficiency = 120/20 = 6 unit/day

Avtar's efficiency = 120/24 = 5 unit/day

Ashok's efficiency = 15 - (6 + 5) = 4 unit/day

Time taken by Ashok = 120/4 = 30 
days

**The answer is 30 days**

questions.question: Catch Cola 300 ML with MRP Rs. 20 is displayed in a Hyper Market with an Offer 'BUY 2 GET 1 FREE'. With this offer, the Hyper Market is giving what per cent discount?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In **Buy X Get Y Free** offers, the discount is calculated on the total number of items.

Effective Discount % = (**Free Items** ÷ **Total Items**) × 100

Discount % = (1 ÷ (2 + 1)) × 100

Discount % = (1 ÷ 3) × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Offer = **Buy 2 Get 1 Free**, **MRP** of 1 bottle of **Catch Cola** = ₹20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db0a78a4a85cced9dc402fb0d0911fd1ecb4e74b9952ee6db1978cc6b97dd87e.png] 

Calculation of **Discount Percentage**:

⇒ Total items received = 2 + 1 = 3

⇒ Total **Marked Price** (MRP) = 3 × ₹20 = ₹60

⇒ Total **Selling Price** (SP) = 2 × ₹20 = ₹40

⇒ Total **Discount** = MRP − SP = 60 − 40 = ₹20

⇒ **Discount %** = (Discount ÷ MRP) × 100

⇒ **Discount %** = (20 ÷ 60) × 100 = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Percentage Formula

The discount percentage is calculated using: (Discount ÷ Marked Price) × 100.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

**Marked Price** is the list price, while **Selling Price** is the final price after subtracting the discount from the Marked Price.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts x% and y% are given, the equivalent single discount = (x + y − (xy ÷ 100))%.

questions.question: If sin α + cos α = (2)/(sqrt3), then what is (tan α + cot α) equal to?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct identity: (sin α + cos α)² = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

Substitute the given value: (2/√3)² = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ 4/3 = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ 1/3 = 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin α + cos α = 2/√3

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2 × a × b

sin² α + cos² α = 1

tan α = sin α / cos α and cot α = cos α / sin α

**Calculations:**

Squaring both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (sin α + cos α)² = (2/√3)²

⇒ sin² α + cos² α + 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3

Substitute sin² α + cos² α = 1:

⇒ 1 + 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3

⇒ 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3 − 1

⇒ 2 × sin α × cos α = 1/3

⇒ sin α × cos α = 1/6

Now evaluate (tan α + cot α):

⇒ tan α + cot α = (sin α / cos α) + (cos α / sin α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = (sin² α + cos² α) / (sin α × cos α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 1 / (sin α × cos α)

Substitute the value of sin α × cos α:

⇒ tan α + cot α = 1 / (1/6)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

sin² α + cos² α = 1, sec² α − tan² α = 1, and cosec² α − cot² α = 1.

Reciprocal Relations

tan α = 1 / cot α, sin α = 1 / cosec α, and cos α = 1 / sec α.

Key Shortcut Formula

The expression tan α + cot α frequently simplifies to 1 / (sin α × cos α), which is a direct and standard substitution for trigonometric simplifications.
</p

questions.question: O is the center of a circle and A is a point on a major arc BC of the circle. ∠BOC and ∠BAC are the angles made by the minor BC on the center and circumference, respectively. If ∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°, then find ∠BOC.
questions.solution:
**Given**

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

**Concept used**

The angle subtended by the arc on the centre of the circle is twice that of the angle subtended by the same arc on some point on the circumference.

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243e0747e4e6f36ce68c36bb2f7919851cbdac845e304cfbffb2aa72e333f14c.png] 

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

∠ABO = ∠OAB = 40° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠ACO = ∠OAC = 30° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠BAC = 40 + 30 = 70°

∠BOC = 2 × 70 = 140°

**The answer is 140°.**

questions.question: If 2x + 3y = 9, and xy = 3, what is 8x³ + 27y³?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **(2x + 3y) = 9** and **xy = 3**.

Use the direct cubic identity: **A³ + B³ = (A + B)³ − 3AB(A + B)**.

Here, A = 2x and B = 3y, so AB = **(2x)(3y) = 6xy = 6 × 3 = 18**.

Substitute values: 9³ − 3 × 18 × 9 ⇒ 729 − 486 = 243.

**∴ The correct answer is 243.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 2x + 3y = 9 and xy = 3

**Formula Used:** (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32fbf265453651e5361c94afdf05b629f000476419d21f68ecad6833cc15708d.png] 

Cubing the equation **2x + 3y = 9** on both sides:

⇒ (2x + 3y)³ = 9³

⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³ + 3 × (2x) × (3y) × (2x + 3y) = 729

⇒ 8x³ + 27y³ + 18xy × (2x + 3y) = 729

Substitute **xy = 3** and **(2x + 3y) = 9** into the equation:

⇒ 8x³ + 27y³ + 18 × 3 × 9 = 729

⇒ 8x³ + 27y³ + 486 = 729

⇒ 8x³ + 27y³ = 729 − 486

⇒ 8x³ + 27y³ = 243

**∴ The correct answer is 243.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The expression a³ + b³ can also be factored as (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).

Cubic Binomial Expansion

(a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³, which is commonly rewritten as a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) for solving algebraic problems.

Difference of Cubes

Similar to the sum, the difference is given by a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) or (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b).</p

questions.question: The average monthly salary of workers in a factory is Rs. 6,000. The average monthly salary of 100 technicians is Rs. 12,000, and the average monthly salary of non-technicians is Rs. 4,000. Find the total number of workers in the factory
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Technicians** to **Non-technicians** by **Alligation**:

(6,000 − 4,000) : (12,000 − 6,000) = 2,000 : 6,000 = 1 : 3

Given: 1 unit (Technicians) = 100

Total workers = 1 + 3 = 4 units = 4 × 100 = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average salary of all workers = ₹ 6,000

⇒ Number of **technicians** = 100

⇒ Average salary of **technicians** = ₹ 12,000

⇒ Average salary of **non-technicians** = ₹ 4,000

**Formula Used:**

Total Salary = Average Salary × Number of Workers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd1230f2a5bc15028f08d6f82a0601ff75f8490350798d0cd887c614fd061754.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total number of workers be **x**.

⇒ Total salary = 6,000 × x

⇒ Total salary = (100 × 12,000) + (x − 100) × 4,000

⇒ 6,000x = 12,00,000 + 4,000x − 4,00,000

⇒ 6,000x − 4,000x = 8,00,000

⇒ 2,000x = 8,00,000

⇒ x = 8,00,000 ÷ 2,000 = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The average of a group is given by (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where A represents the average and n represents the quantity.

Alligation Rule

Quantity of cheaper ÷ Quantity of dearer = (Rate of dearer − Mean rate) ÷ (Mean rate − Rate of cheaper).

Mean Value Property

The mean value of a mixture always lies between the lowest and the highest individual values of its components.

questions.question: ΔPQR and ΔSQR are both isosceles triangles on a common base QR such that P and S lie on the same side of QR. If ∠QSR = 60° and ∠QPR = 100°, then find ∠SRP.
questions.solution:
**Given**

∠QSR = 60° and ∠QPR = 100°

**Calculation**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a4bfb15335f9b95d71c7df28c4dfb852fc2feb359fa0a086e65af5e2003df24.png] **

In ΔSQR, ∠QSR = 60° and SQ = SR

⇒ ∠SQR = ∠SRQ

∠SQR = ∠SRQ = (180 - 60)/2 = 60°

In ΔPQR, ∠QPR = 100° and PQ = PR

⇒ ∠PQR = ∠PRQ

∠PQR = ∠PRQ = (180 - 100)/2 = 40°

From the given diagram,

∠SRP = ∠SRQ - ∠PRQ

⇒ ∠SRP = 60° - 40°

⇒ ∠SRP = 20°

questions.question: A sum of money is divided among A, B, C in the ratio 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 5, respectively. If the share of C is Rs. 300 more than B, then how much more money will A get than B?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **A : B : C** = 3 : 2 : 5.

Difference between **C and B** in units = 5 − 2 = 3 units.

Given 3 units = **Rs. 300** → 1 unit = **Rs. 100**.

Difference between **A and B** in units = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Therefore, 1 unit = **Rs. 100**.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 100.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of shares of **A, B, and C** = 3 : 2 : 5

Difference between **C's share** and **B's share** = Rs. 300

**Formula Used:**

Value of one ratio unit = (Actual Difference) ÷ (Difference in ratio parts)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd56d3a415bd35f7bf8b8e52d0202928a061f1743e277bccf1ca86bc9de34b19.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the shares of **A, B, and C** be 3x, 2x, and 5x respectively.

⇒ Difference between **C and B** = 5x − 2x = 3x

⇒ According to the question: 3x = 300

⇒ x = 300 ÷ 3 = 100

⇒ Difference between **A and B** = 3x − 2x = x

⇒ Required difference = 100

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 100.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio is a comparison of two quantities by division. Proportion is an expression that states two ratios are equal.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a : b = b : c, then c is called the third proportional to a and b, calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a : √b.</p
